summary: Avery Arbaugh is running for Berkeley's Rent Stabilization Board, a local seat focused on tenant protections and rent control. CAIR Action endorsed the general-election bid and Vote for Peace rated the candidate an Ally, both organizations that weigh ceasefire and foreign-policy positions. No personal statement or action by the candidate on Gaza or Palestinian justice appears in the record.
